description:
X-Patrol #1 (April 1996), Amalgam Comics - the Marvel/DC crossover combining X-Force and Doom Patrol. Shatterstarfire, Niles Cable, Beastling, Elasti-Girl and Ferro Man. Cover by Roger Cruz. Direct edition, $1.95 cover price.

Back cover: Fleer NBA Basketball Series 2 ad.

Condition: bright, glossy cover with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
